data.name: Faithful
data.gender_notes: Faithful is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word pistos, meaning 'faithful,' 'trustworthy,' or 'believable.' In Christianity, faithfulness is a central virtue, reflecting one's commitment to God and others. The name Faithful carries the meaning “Steadfast, loyal, trustworthy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Faithful usually hope their child will grow to embody steadfast, loyal, trustworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering trust and loyalty to God and others.
data.etymology: Faithful belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Steadfast, loyal, trustworthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faithful total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: נאמן
in_hebrew.meaning: הוא שם המתאר אדם שנאמן לאלוהים ולזולתו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם נאמן הוא שם תואר המתאר אדם שמראה נאמנות והוא מחויב לאלוהים ולזולתו. הוא מופיע במקרא ככינוי לאלוהים עצמו, המדגיש את נאמנותו של אלוהים לעמו ישראל. הנאמנות הזו היא מרכיב מרכזי ביחסי אלוהים-אדם בתנ'ך.

in_greek.name: Πιστός
in_greek.meaning: Αυτός που έχει πίστη και είναι αξιόπιστος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Πιστός είναι εκείνος που επιδεικνύει πίστη και αξιοπιστία. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο όρος χρησιμοποιείται για να περιγράψει τους πιστούς στο Χριστό, οι οποίοι παραμένουν πιστοί και αφοσιωμένοι στη διδασκαλία του. Η πίστη και η πιστότητα είναι κεντρικές έννοιες στη χριστιανική διδασκαλία.

in_latin.name: Fidelis
in_latin.meaning: Fidelitas et veritas in Deum et hominem
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Fidelis significat fidem et veritatem erga Deum et hominem. In Ecclesia primitiva, fidelis dicebatur qui in fide Christi perseverabat. Fidelitas est virtus quae Deum et proximum coniungit.

in_english.name: Faithful
in_english.meaning: Loyal, devoted, and steadfast in faith and commitment
in_english.long_meaning: The name Faithful conveys a sense of loyalty, devotion, and steadfastness in one's faith and commitments. Derived from the Hebrew 'emen' (נאמן) and Greek 'pistos' (Πιστός), it signifies a person who remains true and dedicated to their beliefs and values. In the Bible, faithfulness is a key attribute of God and a desired quality in His followers. Throughout Christian tradition, the name Faithful has been associated with virtues such as reliability, trustworthiness, and spiritual fidelity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Faithful" has historical significance in Christian tradition, seen in the lives of faithful saints and martyrs who demonstrated unwavering commitment to their beliefs, even in the face of persecution. Faithfulness is also a prominent theme in Christian hymns, prayers, and religious texts, underscoring the moral and ethical importance of being steadfast in one's beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name "Faithful" carries deep spiritual significance, representing one's unwavering connection with God. It serves as a reminder to remain devoted to God and to maintain a steadfast and unwavering trust in His love and guidance. Moreover, being faithful to God entails living a moral and ethical life, demonstrating love and compassion towards others, and spreading the teachings of Christ. Overall, the name "Faithful" symbolizes the idea of being steadfast in one's faith, demonstrating commitment and loyalty to God and the Christian community.
